detailed_description:
MiloR邻域差异丰度检验, 适用于多条件比较

适用场景: 有分组的scRNA-seq, aging, disease, >5样本

分析步骤:
  - KNN graph + neighborhoods: MiloR from Seurat
  - Differential abundance test: testNhoods + spatial FDR
  - Visualization: Significant neighborhoods on UMAP

依赖包: edgeR, Seurat, milo-py, miloR

难度: intermediate

触发提示: "进行差异丰度分析"
